elements.requirement: Section 846 applies to a person who is a company or related party to or from whom a transfer of an intangible fixed asset is made, provided that the basic rule in section 845 would otherwise apply to that person and transfer but does not solely because of section 845(4ZA), and the person's profits and losses are not required under section 147(3) or (5) of TIOPA 2010 to be calculated as if the arm's length provision had been made.
elements.quote: This section applies to a person who is a company or related party to whom, or from whom, a transfer of an intangible fixed asset is made if

elements.requirement: For a company or related party subject to section 846, section 147(3) of TIOPA 2010 applies to that person in relation to the provision comprising or including the transfer as if the reference to the 'potentially advantaged person' were a reference to that person.
elements.quote: Section 147(3) of that Act applies to that person in relation to the provision comprising the transfer, or of which the transfer forms part, as if— (a) the reference to the “potentially advantaged person” were to that person

elements.requirement: For a company or related party subject to section 846, section 147(3) of TIOPA 2010 applies as if the reference to the 'actual provision' were a reference to the provision comprising the transfer or of which the transfer forms part.
elements.quote: the reference to the “actual provision” were to the provision comprising the transfer or of which the transfer forms part

elements.requirement: Section 151(3) of TIOPA 2010 provides further rules concerning the application of the arm's length provision in relation to intangible fixed assets.
elements.quote: See also section 151(3) of that Act for provision about applying the arm’s length provision in relation to intangible fixed assets.
